verdicts.reason: A keeps the brand text readable and stacks it in a sensible top-to-bottom flow, and the illustrations are reasonably sized and scattered down the tall strip. Flaws: an empty white label frame floats in the middle as dead space, the headline order is jumbled (LAVANDER, HOMEMADE LOTION, J'adore Paris), and the illustrations are fragmented. B is worse. Its illustrations shrink to a tiny strip, the white frame holds only stray divider lines, 'HOMEMADE LOTION' is misaligned and orphaned below the frame, and large dead areas fill the rest, so the design is unrecognisable.
